title: 最后一班地铁
blurb_en: Two people fall asleep on the last metro every night, so they make a deal: one sleeps, one stays awake.
blurb_zh: 两个总是坐过站的人在末班地铁上约好：一个睡觉，一个负责叫醒对方。
